messages:
marta: Heads-up — thinking of adding a compact SLO 'minimap' tile in Console. Tiny view that shows per-route threshold (SLO pct), recent noise spike bars (1h/24h), and an exposure flag: off|soft|hard. Will be clickable to full SLO editor.
ash: API question: do we need schema changes to represent exposure semantics? Router currently treats some configs as implicit.
jia: We do. Router has internal soft fallbacks but Console must surface intent. Add explicit enum so Console + router agree on semantics.
sanjay: Telemetry: minimap needs near-real-time per-minute noise counts and sample buckets. For low-traffic routes sampling bias is concerning. Propose deterministic reservoir per-route + traffic-weighted sampling. Tag events with 'slo_minimap_v1' for backfill checks.
cassie: UX: minimap must be micro — color strip + tiny bars. Show suppressed icon when notifications are silenced. Hover explains exposure (soft -> degrade, hard -> escalate).
ash: Draft API example:```json
{
  "route": "text.generate.v1",
  "slo": 0.995,
  "alerting": {
    "notify": ["pagerduty:infra", "#gen-models"],
    "suppress_until": null
  },
  "exposure": "soft"  // enum: "off" | "soft" | "hard"
}
```
marta: Where do notify defaults live? Service-level inherit vs per-route explicit? I prefer inherit with per-route overrides to avoid duplication.
jia: Agreed. Schema should support inherit and an explicit per-route notify array that can opt-out.
sanjay: For sampling implementation I'll prototype: deterministic reservoir (seeded by route id) + windowed traffic weight. That should reduce churn and make backfills stable.
cassie: Console path: wire minimap to existing /slo/telemetry but add lightweight /slo/minimap/raw to avoid heavy aggregation when users open a page. Minimizes cost.
deploy-bot: deploy:console-minimap v0.1 canary started in eu-west-1
ash: Security nuance: for tenant-scoped Dedicated/private installs we must whitelist allowed notify channels (no arbitrary PD keys or external webhooks). Add allow_list in schema and Console validation to prevent leaks.
marta: Excellent catch. Validation should be enforced at save time and during rollouts.
jia: Also add offline fallback: if telemetry missing or delayed show 'unknown' state instead of green. Avoid false confidence.
sanjay: I'll run the sampler against 30d historical traffic tomorrow and report bias metrics.
cassie: I'll update figma and produce microstates for 0,1,2,3 bars + suppressed + unknown.
ash: I'll open the API PR with schema, migration notes, and a compat shim returning legacy format if client passes accept-headers.
marta: Rollout plan: canary (eu-west-1) -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitor minimap telemetry coverage, error-rate, and noise-delta regressions. Add rollback steps.
jia: +1 for plan, will review the PR this afternoon.
sanjay: Prototype done tomorrow AM.
cassie: Mockups by EOD.
marta: Thanks all — I'll link this thread to the PR and attach the rollout checklist. Ping me for approvals.
